reply:
CMD is overridable at runtime; ENTRYPOINT is not without the flag. 

`docker run image sh` replaces the CMD. To override ENTRYPOINT, you need `docker run --entrypoint sh image`.

So with `CMD ["node", "server.js"]` and no ENTRYPOINT in the Dockerfile, `docker run image sh` gives you the shell. No new image needed.
